parsed.notes:
Minimum Qualifications supplies required skills; Preferred Qualifications makes its skills optional. Responsibilities and company-description technologies are excluded.
Retrieval and context pipelines maps to RAG; no additional parent data-pipelines skill is inferred. Generic latency optimization is not assumed to mean model inference optimization.
Offline/online scoring and release validation are covered by evaluation; distributed tracing is covered by observability.
OpenTelemetry and MCP are examples for a single ecosystem-contribution ask and share an alternative group. AI/ML, agents, and observability also have independent qualifying mentions and remain outside that group.
SRE and incident-management domains are excluded as domain knowledge. Communication and mentoring are excluded as soft skills. Design reviews and technical documentation are retained literally as technical practices.
No German-language requirement or degree is mentioned.
